_title: dossiq: the term on the case, its seven states and extending
_note: What you see: the term block of a case in its seven states: on track, 14 days left (warning), 7 days left (urgent), expired (Term expired), already extended (Extension: already extended, Extend disabled), paused (Stands still, with the reminders) and granted by operation of law (case type Regular environmental permit). On the right the Extend the term dialog with the required reason. Generic: the days come from the case type's statutory term.
_title_nl: dossiq: termijn op de zaak, de zeven standen en verdagen
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: het termijnblok van een zaak in zijn zeven standen: op koers, nog 14 dagen (waarschuwing), nog 7 dagen (urgent), verlopen (Termijn verlopen), al verdaagd (Verdaging: reeds verdaagd, Verdagen uit), opgeschort (Staat stil, met de herinneringen) en van rechtswege verleend (zaaktype Omgevingsvergunning regulier). Rechts de dialoog Termijn verdagen met de verplichte reden. Generiek: de dagen komen uit de wettelijke termijn van het zaaktype.
dossiq: termijn op de zaak, de vijf stan: dossiq: the term on the case, its five states and extending
Het termijnblok rechts op elke zaak, in: The term block on the right of every case, in its seven states. The days and the colour follow from the case type's statutory term (here 4 weeks, one extension of 2 weeks). On the right the dialog that opens on Extend.
Beslissen uiterlijk 12 april 2026 · wett: Decide by 12 April 2026 · statutory 4 weeks from 15 March
Over twee weken moet het besluit de deur: The decision has to go out in two weeks. Extend in time if the documents are not in yet.
Zonder besluit of verdaging voor 12 apri: Without a decision or an extension before 12 April the statutory term expires.
Beslisdatum was 12 april 2026, 3 dagen g: Decision date was 12 April 2026, 3 days ago
Neem het besluit zo snel mogelijk. De ve: Take the decision as soon as possible. The requester can give the municipality notice of default.
Beslissen uiterlijk 26 april 2026 · verd: Decide by 26 April 2026 · extended on 29 March by 14 days
Verdagen kan één keer. De waarschuwingen: Extending is allowed once. The warnings now count from 26 April.
Nog 14 dagen zodra de termijn weer loopt: 14 days left once the term runs again · paused since 2 April, reason: waiting on the applicant (supplement requested)
Elke 5 dagen zonder antwoord gaat een he: Every 5 days without a reply a reminder goes to the address of the request, with an entry on the timeline. After the last reminder the team lead hears about it once.
Van rechtswege verleend (zaaktype Omgevi: Granted by operation of law (case type Environmental permit, regular)
Beslistermijn 8 weken vanaf 1 maart 2026: Decision term 8 weeks from 1 March 2026, without a decision and without extension
WAARSCHUWING: Vergunning van rechtswege: WARNING: Permit granted by operation of law on 26 April 2026
Dit zaaktype valt onder de lex silencio: This case type falls under the lex silencio positivo. Team lead Anouk Bakker got the task Assess permit granted by operation of law.
De omvang van het verzoek: de adviezen v: The size of the request: the advice of two departments over two years still has to be found and assessed.
Verplicht. De verzoeker leest deze reden: Required. The requester reads this reason in the message.
De beslisdatum schuift 14 dagen op, van: The decision date moves 14 days, from 12 April to 26 April 2026. The requester gets a message with this reason. The extension goes into the case history. This is allowed once.
Na het verdagen: wat Volgende stap zegt: After the extension: what Next step says

Reden: geen kanaal bekend, geen e-mailad: Reason: no channel known, no e-mail address and no Berichtenbox. Tell the requester another way before 12 April.
De termijn is verdaagd tot 26 april en d: The term is extended to 26 April and the requester was told
De verdaging staat, wat er ook met het b: The extension stands, whatever became of the notice. A case without a statutory term says: no notice needed, no statutory term.
